raw_text: In a FY26 renewal review call with Acme Legal, the General Counsel (Priya Nair) and Head of Knowledge Management (Marcus Webb) disclosed that competitor LegalEdge demoed a newly launched contract review module about three weeks prior. The two capabilities that stood out to Acme's paralegal team were (1) fully native operation inside Microsoft Word, with redlining performed in Word itself rather than a separate window or web app, and (2) notably fast redlining/turn-comparison, demonstrated live on a complex master services agreement. Acme stressed this was a demo of a new module, not a completed pilot, and that Litera's integration reliability remains valued especially for audits. Pricing was mentioned by LegalEdge only informally. Acme has not decided to switch but raised LegalEdge as an active consideration, with the in-Word paralegal experience being the main draw. Litera's AE committed to sharing the drafting roadmap before renewal and offered direct time with Acme's paralegals.
